body.statement: For \(K_s(w)=E[K(w+s\Sigma^{1/2}\xi)]\), \(\xi\sim N_d(0,I_d)\), and every action functional \(f\in[0,R_f]\), \[\sup_{h\in\mathbb R^d}|E_hf\{K_s(W)\}-E_hf\{K(W)\}|\le R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\},\] and \(\|K_s(w)-K_s(w')\|_1\le\sqrt{2/\pi}\|w-w'\|_{\Sigma^{-1}}/s\).
body.justification: The uniform kernel-independent bound converts arbitrary measurable honest rules into quantitatively gridable rules.
body.gap: Jones and Peet smooth a discontinuous terminal cost inside a fixed Gaussian integral; they do not smooth an arbitrary randomized rule uniformly over all shifted means.
body.consumer: The finite-rule enumeration uses this modulus to choose observation meshes without regularity assumptions on a near-minimizer.
